news.headline: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin inactive after Friday injury
news.description: Commanders wide receiver Terry McLaurin will not play against the Colts because of a hamstring injury suffered in practice Friday.

news.headline: Eagles' DeVonta Smith out vs. Rams with hamstring injury
news.description: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith will miss Sunday's game due to a lingering hamstring injury and will be joined on the sideline by linebacker Zack Baun (concussion).

news.headline: Texans get WR Nico Collins (hamstring) back vs. Cowboys
news.description: The winless Texans got good news Friday as star wide receiver Nico Collins is set to return Sunday from a hamstring injury that forced him to miss Houston's last two games.

news.headline: Vikings' Justin Jefferson out vs. Dolphins with ankle injury
news.description: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson won't play against the Dolphins because of a sprained left ankle, but coach Kevin O'Connell is hopeful he can return in Week 5 vs. the Saints.

news.headline: Sources: TE Sam LaPorta, Lions break off contract talks
news.description: The Lions and star tight end Sam LaPorta have broken off contract talks, sources told NFL Network, after attempting to work out a long-term deal for the first few weeks of the season.

news.headline: Panthers put Legette on IR; Coker also likely out vs. Lions
news.description: The Panthers have placed 2024 first-round pick Xavier Legette on injured reserve ahead of Sunday's primetime matchup against the Lions. Wide receiver Jalen Coker is also unlikely to play against the Lions, sources told ESPN.

news.headline: Fantasy football last-minute pickups for Week 4: Raymond, Waller among top options

news.headline: Terry McLaurin could miss Sunday's game against Colts

news.headline: Colts WR Keenan Allen (groin) out vs. Commanders in London
news.description: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen has a groin injury that will force him to sit out Sunday's game in London against the Commanders.

news.headline: 49ers WR Mike Evans a game-time decision with rib injury
news.description: Niners wide receiver Mike Evans is questionable for Sunday, but he said he will give "my best" to play against the Broncos as he deals with a rib injury.
